units: decimal fractions; '_ann' = annualised (mean x12, vol x sqrt(12)); skew/kurtosis are of monthly returns

equity_intl_proxy.method: fixed non-negative weights summing to 1 on French country value-weight USD market returns, least-squares fitted to the French Developed ex US market return

correlations.note: pairwise-complete Pearson correlations; n_obs gives the sample size of each pair. unemp_chg = change in unemployment rate, long_yield_chg = change in monthly-average long yield. 'real' matrices deflate every return series except cpi by cpi.

autocorrelation.note: sample autocorrelation of monthly series at the given lags (months); abs_nominal = autocorrelation of |return| (volatility clustering). Home-price and pre-1962 bond autocorrelations are inflated by index smoothing / interpolation / monthly-average yields.

variance_ratios.note: Lo-MacKinlay overlapping variance ratio of log returns, VR(q) = Var(q-month)/(q*Var(1-month)), horizons in months (60 = 5y, 120 = 10y). <1 mean reversion, >1 momentum/persistence. Implied annualised vol at horizon q = vol_1m_annualised * sqrt(VR(q)).

business_cycle.note: recession = NBER USREC (1 from the month after the peak through the trough). mean_ann/vol_ann are annualised from the months in each state.

threshold_method.description: month t is 'turbulent' when the annualised standard deviation of the trailing 12 monthly nominal US equity returns (months t-11..t) exceeds the 75th percentile of that statistic over the sample; otherwise 'calm'.

gaussian_hmm.description: two-state Gaussian hidden Markov model fitted by Baum-Welch EM to monthly log excess returns ln(1+equity_us) - ln(1+tbill), initialised from the threshold classification. Parameters are monthly (log excess return); *_ann fields are annualised. Per-regime statistics of the other series use the smoothed-probability classification P(turbulent)>0.5.

long_yield_ltgovtbd_vs_shiller_pre1953.note: Shiller's pre-1953 long rate is annual (January) data linearly interpolated to months, so LTGOVTBD (true monthly averages) is used for returns; Shiller is a level cross-check only.

bond10_calendar_year_returns_1928_on.published_reference: Damodaran 'Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills' 10-year T-bond 1928-2025 (histretSP.html, retrieved 2026-11-17): arithmetic 4.82%, geometric 4.53%, sd 7.90%; 1928-2023: 4.86% / 4.57% / 7.95% (1982 +32.81%, 2008 +20.10%, 2009 -11.12%, 2022 -17.83%, 2025 +7.80%); correlation of his annual returns with this series 0.989. Ibbotson SBBI 1926-2023 (quoted from memory, NOT verified): intermediate-term government arithmetic ~5.0% / sd ~5.6%; long-term government arithmetic ~5.7% / sd ~9.7%.
